title: Stellarity Cobblemon Compat
description: This Datapack adds Spawn Tags for Stellarity Biomes!
body:
This mod adds the Biome Spawn tags that Cobblemon wants to spawn Pokémon properly in the Stellarity End Biomes!

- What this Datapack does: Allow Pokémon to spawn in the Modded Stellarity End Biomes
- Why you would want to download it: Because by default, Pokémon will not spawn in the Stellarity End Biomes, and with this Datapack, now they will
- That's... it, that's all it does, that's all it's intended to do, just serve as a compatibility layer, nothing else, and it works, it uh, it does its job, ya'know?, like, there are Pokemon in the Modded biomes from stellarity now; uh, this datapack is like, 15 lines of code, and all they do is say "Hey, Pokemon who normmaly spawn in the end, Yeah, you can spawn in these biomes too, cause i say so, im the Cobblemon Stellarity Compat Datapack, and im so awsome and cool" and the Pokemon are like "Oh, Awsome, all the Vanilla End biomes dont exist with Stellarity so i had nowhere to spawn, so it's so cool that sombody made you.... I love you", and then the Datapack gets kinda weirded out by the Pokemon cause they just met.... uh, anyway, thats... thats what it does, thats all it does... uh, You should download it and put it in your world file's Datapack folder like any other datapack... cause You know, thats... how datapacks work.
